crossRefs.note: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded…
The people served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all…
Joash did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came, and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.
They abandoned the house of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and the idols, so wrath came…
For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out…
Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Yahweh…

people.name: Israel

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Israel served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Yahweh, that he had worked for Israel.
translations.bsb: Israel had served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced all the works that the LORD had done for Israel.
translations.kjv: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.
translations.asv: And Israel served Jehovah all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, and had known all the work of Jehovah, that he had wrought for Israel.
